diagnosis_in.target: _choose 함수 내 evading=True 분기의 필터 조건 및 회피 종료 로직
diagnosis_in.direction: 1. evading=True 시 stc >= 0.2m 강제 조건 제거, stc >= 0.0만 허용. 2. 회피 종료 조건으로 (ttc >= _TTC_TRIG and clr_all >= _CLR_GO * _RESUME_CLR_F)만 요구. 3. 회피 중 st_n < 0.15m인 구역 진입 시 _choose 재호출 대신 속도 유지하며 lateral 이동 유도. 4. slow_mode 진입 시 _CLR_STOP 기준을 0.35로 상향해 과도한 감속 방지. 5. 제자리 회전 시 w=0.05 rad/s 미만이면 전진 속도 0.5m/s 유지하도록 _choose 수정. 6. 회피 종료 후 0.2s 이내 재진입 방지 위해 _cool_until을 0.2s로 단축

diagnosis_out.chosen: Extend mover track retention time and use velocity vectors for evasion direction, as it addresses root cause (poor tracking) and improves evasion effectiveness
diagnosis_out.direction:
1. Increase track retention from 0.4s to 2.0s in _update_tracks to keep mover tracks longer for accurate velocity estimation.
2. In _choose during evasion, compute desired heading perpendicular to mover velocity vector (v: vx, vy) → desired heading = atan2(vx, -vy).
3. Add score bonus for commands whose yaw change aligns with this desired heading (e.g., bonus = _LAT_PRIO_W * cos(desired_heading - w)).
4. Ensure static clearance (stc) ≥ 0.0 remains required but prioritize lateral movement when mover is approaching (closing speed > 0).
5. Reduce _EVADE_MAX to 4.0s to limit prolonged ineffective evasion.
6. Increase _LAT_PRIO_W to 4.0 to strengthen lateral movement incentive during evasion.
